tables.caption_latex: Common training, evaluation and device-study settings.
rows_latex: 300 epochs; seeds 101/202/303; FP32; $640\times640$ input; teacher/student batch sizes 4/8.
SGD; initial learning rate 0.01, final factor 0.01, momentum 0.937, weight decay $5\times10^{-4}$; cosine scheduling.
Mosaic/mixup probabilities 1.0/0.05; native framework losses, scaling and warm-up, including YOLOv7's minimum 1000 warm-up batches.
Square letterboxing; FP32; confidence floor 0.001; NMS IoU 0.65; model maxDet 300 and COCO maxDets 100.
One Orin Nano Super 8 GB; 15 W dynamic clocks; Ubuntu 20.04.6/L4T R35.6.4; native PyTorch FP16 or TensorRT 8.5.2.2.
One Pi~5 Model B 8 GB; Debian 13/aarch64; Python 3.13.5; ONNX Runtime 1.23.2 CPU FP32; four intra-op/one inter-op threads, spinning disabled, one OpenCV thread.
The same 1475-frame 3840$\times$2160 file; batch 1, input 640, confidence 0.25, NMS IoU 0.65, maxDet 300. Jetson uses full-file passes; Pi uses the first 300 frames.
R04/R02: 750 frames each, 26/19 trajectories and 1188/1227 visible GT boxes. Quality includes all frames and empty GT/predictions; the cost workload concatenates both clips (1500 frames).
Single-class COCO AP50 and AP50:95, using the 101-point recall grid and IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95; COCO maxDets 100.
TrackEval CLEAR/Identity at IoU 0.5: MOTA, MOTP, IDF1, ID switches, FP, FN and fragments. MOTP is mean matched-box IoU. Combined scores use the official sequence combiners.
Frames divided by wall time, from file open/decode through preprocessing, forward, NMS, CPU detections, prescribed logging and termination/flushing; full EOF on Jetson, 300-frame termination on Pi.
Sampled formal-window RSS and lifetime VmHWM have overlapping scopes and are not summed. CUDA forward timing excludes decoding and postprocessing.
Mean module VDD\_IN over the same timing window, including background activity; excludes wall-plug and isolated-GPU interpretations.
Separately measured, uncalibrated PMIC output rails; VDD\_CORE load-minus-baseline increments are formed within run. Direct 5V/USB loads are outside this rail measurement.
